review.title: Sell or add
review.intro: Every holding scored on business quality and on price, and sized against the rest of the book: what to sell, what to trim, what to add to — and which names outside the portfolio are worth buying. Search any ticker below to weigh it beside your watchlist.
review.unpriced: {count} position(s) without a price, held at cost
review.empty_body: Import your transactions or follow a few tickers, and this page will say what to sell, what to add to and what to buy.
review.plan_sells_help: Money freed by every sell and trim below, at today's prices.
review.plan_buys_help: Money needed to take every name marked 'add' up to its target weight.
review.plan_net_help: To add minus to sell. Negative means the moves free cash; positive means they need new money.
review.plan_tax_help: What the sales add to this year's tax bill ({code}), replayed on your own lots and the gains and losses already booked this year.
review.moves_none: No move stands out: every holding is either a hold, a fund or cash.
review.move_no_tax: No extra tax: the sale books a loss or is offset
review.buy_after: Buy after {date}: a loss sold inside the repurchase window would be undone
review.map_help: Up is a better business, right is a cheaper one. The shaded corner is where 'add' and 'buy' live; the dashed lines are the bars the verdicts use.
review.map_tap: hover over or tap a dot to see why
review.map_missing: {count} without a score (bets, funds, cash or missing data)
review.held_help: Actions first, then the quiet rows. Quality and price are 0–100 scores from the fundamentals on each ticker page.
review.outside_help: Your watchlist's names you do not hold, plus any ticker typed above. 'Buy' needs both a good business and a fair price.
review.outside_empty: No outside names yet: follow a ticker or type one in the box above.
review.coins: Crypto stays out of this read: a coin has no filings to score. It is {weight} of your book:
review.col_quality_help: 0–100. A mature business: ROIC, operating margin, FCF yield and moat, plus the rule of 40 while sales still grow 20%+. A fast grower (25%+ sales growth, under 10% operating margin): rule of 40, gross margin and moat. 60+ is good; under 45, weak.
review.col_cheapness_help: 0–100, higher is cheaper. A mature business: forward P/E, FCF yield and EV/EBITDA. A fast grower: EV/sales per point of growth and FCF yield. 50+ is cheap.
review.col_weight_help: This position's share of the priced book.
review.col_target_help: The weight the verdict takes it to: 0% to sell, 10% to cut a concentration, 5% to add.
review.col_move_help: Money to sell (−) or buy (+) to reach the target, at today's price.
review.col_tax_help: Extra tax this year if the sale is made, with your tax jurisdiction and lots.
review.col_pnl_help: Unrealised gain or loss on the position against its cost.
review.metric_owner_fcf_yield_help: Free cash flow minus share-based pay, over market cap: the yield the scores use.
review.metric_revenue_growth_help: Revenue growth over the last year, from the quote source.
review.metric_fcf_margin_help: Free cash flow as a share of revenue: how much of each sale is left as cash.
review.metric_runway_years_help: Cash and short-term investments over last year's cash burn: years before it needs new money. Blank for a business that makes cash.
review.ask: Draft a question for the AI
review.ask_help: Writes the question into the chat with what is on screen — filters included — for you to edit and send.
review.prompt_intro: Review this sell-or-add read of my portfolio ({date}, in {base}) and challenge it.
review.prompt_held: Held (verdict, weight → target, quality/price out of 100, reasons, figures):
review.prompt_ask: For each one: what the filter misses, what would change the decision, and in what order you would do it. Check the current figures yourself before giving a view.
review.filter_weight_help: Only holdings have a weight; outside names follow the sector filter alone.
review.filter_include_help: What to compare: your book, your starred names, your whole watchlist or one of its groups. Picks add up; a ticker typed in above is always included.
review.disclaimer: A screen over your own records and public fundamentals, not advice. The scores miss what the filings do not show.
review.verdict_sell_help: Weak on both quality and price, or a position under 0.5% not good enough to grow into a real one. Target: 0%.
review.verdict_trim_help: 15% or more of the book in one name (cut to 10%), or a weak business that weighs 6%+ or carries 10%+ of the risk (keep half).
review.verdict_hold_help: Nothing to do: neither quality, price nor size asks for a move.
review.verdict_add_help: Quality 60+ and price 50+ while under 5% of the book: raise it to 5%.
review.verdict_core_help: A fund: kept as the core, with no company's numbers to judge.
review.verdict_cash_help: Money market: parked cash, no business verdict.
review.verdict_buy_help: Not held, quality 60+ and price 50+: a good business at a good price.
review.verdict_watch_help: A good business still dear, or a decent one at a good price: wait for a better entry.
review.verdict_pass_help: Neither quality nor price clears the bar.
review.verdict_bet_help: A business still proving its product: little or no revenue (or losing more than it sells), cash burning, valued on what it may become. No quality or price score fits it; held, it is kept to 3% of the book, because the outcome can be most of the money either way.
review.verdict_unrated_help: No reliable numbers to score: a fund, a coin, or fundamentals missing or broken at the source.
review.reason_quality_help: Quality score 60 or more (ROIC, operating margin, FCF yield and moat).
review.reason_cheap_help: Price score 50 or more (forward P/E, FCF yield, EV/EBITDA).
review.reason_high_roic_help: Return on invested capital of 25% or more.
review.reason_low_roic_help: Return on invested capital under 8%: barely covers its cost of capital.
review.reason_wide_moat_help: Moat score 70 or more: a durable competitive edge in the filings.
review.reason_negative_fcf_help: Free cash flow below zero: the business consumes cash.
review.reason_loss_making_help: Forward P/E at or below zero: analysts expect a loss next year.
review.reason_buybacks_help: Share count falling 2%+ a year: the company buys back its own stock.
review.reason_dilution_help: Share count growing 3%+ a year: your slice shrinks.
review.reason_growth_help: Revenue growing 20%+ a year, sustained: the lower of the last quarter on a year before and the multi-year rate.
review.reason_concentrated: too big a share of the book
review.reason_concentrated_help: 15% or more of the book in this one name; the target is 10%.
review.reason_risk_heavy_help: Carries 10% or more of the book's volatility.
review.reason_underweight_help: One of the best on both scores, yet under 5% of the book.
review.reason_small_help: Under 0.5% of the book: too small to move it.
review.reason_data_suspect_help: FCF yield over 25% or enterprise value at or below zero — almost always mixed currencies at the source. FCF and EV/EBITDA are ignored.
review.reason_no_data_help: The source has too few fundamentals to score it.
review.reason_fund_help: A fund or ETF: judged by what it holds, not here.
review.reason_crypto_help: A coin has no balance sheet or income statement to score.
review.reason_pre_revenue_help: Little or no revenue against its price (40x sales or more) and burning cash: the price is a bet on a product not yet sold.
review.reason_deep_burn_help: Operating loss larger than all its revenue, with cash going out: the sales do not cover the product yet, so it is judged as a bet, not on its ratios.
review.reason_trial_risk_help: A drug developer before its products sell: one failed trial or a regulator's no can take most of the value. Spread across names, size small.
review.reason_patent_risk_help: A drug maker lives on patents that expire: check when the main ones run out and what replaces them. Expiry dates are not in the data.
review.reason_growth_stage_help: Sales growing 25%+ a year with operating margin under 10%: judged on growth, gross margin and the rule of 40, not on today's profits.
review.reason_rule_of_40_help: Sales growth plus FCF margin is 40% or more: growth that pays for itself.
review.reason_short_runway_help: Cash covers under 1.5 years of the current burn: expect new shares or debt, often at a bad price.
review.reason_long_runway_help: Cash covers 3+ years of the current burn: time to reach the next milestone without raising.
review.reason_bet_heavy_help: A bet above 3% of the book: trimmed to 3%, so a failure costs a slice and not the year.
review.reason_fcf_float_help: Free cash flow over twice EBITDA even net of share-based pay: customer money, advance payments or a loan book passing through. Not counted as yield.
review.reason_share_pay_help: Share-based pay is half or more of its free cash flow: the reported FCF counts it as free. Scored on FCF net of it.
